task.objective: Preserve the verified 179-declaration seed, then add only Runtime-validated proof batches selected from the seeded tree's remaining declarations.
gates: Runtime executes lake build directly without a shell pipeline
Root and coordinators cannot edit benchmark source files
Only one source writer is active or awaiting validation at a time
Dependency findings are handed to downstream nodes with explicit file ownership
A failed writer or build restores the previous verified green snapshot

nodes.assignment: Inspect the seeded green tree. Confirm Player.lean, Functor.lean, and Mathlib/Small.lean are already solved; then rank remaining declarations in Tactic/GameCmp.lean, Game/Small.lean, Game/Graph.lean, and Game/Specific/Domineering.lean. Report exact names, local dependencies, and focused build targets without editing.
nodes.guide: Do not assign work back to the three seed-complete files. Put seven GameCmp simp-shaped declarations first, four lawnmower declarations second, and identify the safest adjacent Graph declarations.

nodes.assignment: Coordinate the Runtime-spawned scouts and serial writers. Relay each scout result only to a writer that owns the target file, wait for Runtime candidate validation, and stop rejected routes. Never edit source, never ask a child to edit outside its access contract, and never submit.
nodes.guide: Treat Runtime dependency handoffs and access-contract notifications as authoritative. Player.lean, Functor.lean, and Mathlib/Small.lean are seed-complete and must not consume another writer.

nodes.assignment: Repair exactly the seven remaining declarations in CombinatorialGames/Tactic/GameCmp.lean: Set.exists_mem_empty, Set.forall_singleton, Set.exists_singleton, forall_lt_zero, exists_lt_zero, forall_lt_one, and exists_lt_one. Test the minimal `simp` proof for each, run a focused module build, and finish so Runtime can run the authoritative full build.
nodes.guide: Own only GameCmp.lean. Use structured workspace edits, preserve signatures and attributes, and do not change the game_cmp macro or imports. If `simp` fails for one declaration, keep the successful adjacent proofs and report the exact remaining goal.

nodes.assignment: Read Game/Small.lean and its imported Dicotic, Numeric, order, and infinitesimal lemmas. Derive proof skeletons for IGame.Dicotic.lt_of_numeric_of_pos and lt_of_numeric_of_neg. Send exact candidate terms and required instance paths without editing.
nodes.guide: Explore one route through existing order/number lemmas and one route through game comparison. State compiler-checkable snippets, not general advice.

nodes.assignment: Independently derive proof skeletons for IGame.Impartial.lt_of_numeric_of_pos and lt_of_numeric_of_neg in Game/Small.lean. Check whether Impartial supplies Dicotic and whether the two declarations should delegate to the Dicotic theorems. Report exact Lean terms without editing.
nodes.guide: Verify namespace qualification, instance synthesis, and argument order. Prefer a short delegation proof over reproducing the hard theorem.

nodes.assignment: Rank the fourteen remaining sorries in Game/Graph.lean by proof risk. Produce exact proof sketches for the definitional image/membership lemmas first, including moves_toLGame, toLGame_def', toLGame_def, mem_moves_toLGame_of_mem, moveRecOn_eq, and their toIGame analogues. Do not edit.
nodes.guide: Use definitions and existing corec/fix simp lemmas. Separate compiler-supported short candidates from speculative recursive proofs so the writer can stop before risky edits.

nodes.assignment: Use both Runtime-delivered scout reports to repair the four remaining lawnmower declarations in CombinatorialGames/Game/Small.lean. Work one theorem or dependency pair at a time, keep only focused-build successes, and finish for Runtime full-build validation.
nodes.guide: Own only Game/Small.lean. Try the two Dicotic declarations before delegating the Impartial declarations. Do not touch the already completed Mathlib/Small.lean.

nodes.assignment: Use the Runtime-delivered Graph scout report to repair a conservative adjacent batch in CombinatorialGames/Game/Graph.lean. Start with definitional and membership lemmas, run a focused build after each small batch, and stop before speculative recursive or negation proofs if evidence is weak.
nodes.guide: Own only Game/Graph.lean. Preserve public signatures and universe levels. A smaller accepted batch is better than a broad rejected edit.

nodes.assignment: Inspect the single official new_bad declaration IGame.Domineering.instRepr and nearby remaining sorries in CombinatorialGames/Game/Specific/Domineering.lean. First seek a signature-preserving way to eliminate the regression; then attempt only locally supported short proofs. If the regression is transitive or no safe edit is justified, make no speculative change and report the evidence.
nodes.guide: Own only Domineering.lean. Do not change public declaration types, add axioms, or broaden into Graph, IGame, Classes, or Player. Keep only focused-build successes.

nodes.assignment: After every writer is terminal and Runtime has accepted or restored each batch, run a read-only full build and inspect git diff for out-of-scope changes. Confirm the tree matches the last Runtime-verified green checkpoint and report exact commands, exit codes, changed files, and unresolved declaration risk.
nodes.guide: Do not edit and do not submit. Treat Runtime candidate-validation events as authoritative; flag any source change not owned by one of the four writers.
